explanation: This component is 0 at every D1 and D2 step and only turns on at GO, where it is nearly always high: 10 when the agent chooses a1 late in the episode (about trial 70 onward), and 9 for a1 earlier or for a2. It drops to 8 at GO when the agent chose a2 and the previous trial was unrewarded (7 after several unrewarded trials in a row), and the rare small values at D1 (around 1) come only after a run of unrewarded trials.
